title: SPARQ: Synthetic Problem Generation for Reasoning via Quality-Diversity Algorithms
paper_type_zh: 质量—多样性合成数学问题构造与规模研究
best_for_zh: 研究合成题目、策略相对难度筛选、质量—多样性搜索和数学 SFT 数据构造的读者
one_line: SPARQ recursively mutates MATH problems, scores each child with 16 student rollouts, and turns successful student solutions from nontrivial children into SFT tuples organized by learned skill cells.
SPARQ 递归变异 MATH 题目，用 16 条学生 rollout 估计子题难度，并将非平凡子题的成功学生解答组织成按技能单元索引的 SFT 元组。
why: It makes problem generation, difficulty filtering, diversity sampling, and tuple assembly explicit while exposing invalid-problem propagation, verifier dependence, yield, and missing-release risks.
inclusion_reason: SPARQ specifies a quality-diversity search recipe that converts recursively mutated math problems and policy-relative answer-agreement rollouts into student-generated SFT tuples.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The verified source is arXiv:2506.06499v2, a 2025 preprint marked “Under review.” Synthetic reasoning pipelines often expand fixed problem sets with more solutions or ask a stronger teacher to invent new questions. The first approach cannot enlarge the problem distribution; the second lacks a natural ground-truth signal for detecting trivial, impossible, inconsistent, or repetitive generated questions.

SPARQ treats new-problem construction as an open-ended search over problem-solution pairs. It starts from 7,500 MATH training examples, recursively mutates sampled parents, estimates each child’s policy-relative difficulty with student rollouts, and represents coverage through model-assigned skill sets. The relevant data object is not merely a generated question. It includes the parent and child problem-solution pair, intended numerical answer, 16 student attempts, extracted-answer agreement, solve rate, quality score, skill cell, archive/working-set decision, and successful student solution selected as an SFT target.

The decision boundary is intentionally narrow. Numerical agreement with a generator-written intended answer is a scalable filter, not an independent proof that the problem is well posed or that its intermediate reasoning is valid. The paper itself finds that harder retained items are more likely invalid. This makes SPARQ valuable to the data-construction track as both a concrete recipe and a case study in proxy failure; no official code or generated corpus was confirmed.

已核验来源为 arXiv:2506.06499v2，一篇标注“Under review”的 2025 年预印本。合成推理流水线通常为固定题集增加解答，或让更强教师编写新题。前者无法扩展题目分布；后者缺少天然 ground-truth 信号，难以识别过易、不可解、内部矛盾或重复的新题。

SPARQ 将新题构造视为对题目—解答对的开放搜索。它从 7,500 条 MATH 训练样本出发，递归变异抽样父题，用学生 rollout 估计每个子题相对于当前策略的难度，再用模型分配的技能集表示覆盖范围。目标数据对象不只是一道生成题，还包括父子题解对、预期数值答案、16 条学生尝试、提取答案的一致标签、solve rate、质量分数、技能单元、archive/working-set 决策，以及最终作为 SFT 目标的成功学生解答。

这里的判断边界必须收窄。与生成器所写预期答案的数值一致是一种可扩展筛选器，却不是对题目良定义性或中间推理正确性的独立证明。论文自己发现，较难的保留样本更可能无效。因此，SPARQ 对数据构造轨道的价值既在于具体配方，也在于揭示代理失效；本次未确认到官方代码或生成语料发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SPARQ separates mutation, policy-relative verification, and archive management. In the main configuration, Gemma-2-27B-it receives a parent problem and solution and emits a novel child problem plus intended solution. A MATH-SFT Gemma-2-9B student then attempts the child 16 times. A rollout succeeds when its extracted numerical final answer agrees with the intended answer. If the agreement fraction is (p), quality is (1-p) when (p\in[0.1,0.9]) and zero otherwise. With 16 attempts, this effectively retains children solved between 2 and 14 times.

Gemma-2-9B-it assigns each child no more than three skills from the 100 most frequent skills in the seed set. Those skill sets define diversity cells. Static variants keep mutating only the seed working set; dynamic variants insert high-quality children and evict low-quality members. Uniform variants sample individual parents uniformly; diverse variants first sample a skill cell uniformly. All generated children enter the archive, but only positive-quality children survive final filtering.

The final supervision is student-authored. Every retained problem is paired with each successful student verification, rather than with the generator’s intended solution. Thus solve-rate outcomes serve both as a construction score and a source of reasoning traces. This is a quality-diversity data curriculum, not an RLVR optimizer: the reported downstream update is SFT, and the numerical checker operates only at final-answer level.

SPARQ 将变异、策略相对验证和 archive 管理解耦。主要配置中，Gemma-2-27B-it 接收父题及其解答，输出新子题与预期解；经过 MATH SFT 的 Gemma-2-9B 学生再尝试子题 16 次。若 rollout 提取出的最终数值答案与预期答案一致，就记为成功。设一致比例为 (p)，当 (p\in[0.1,0.9]) 时质量为 (1-p)，否则为零。以 16 次尝试计算时，实际保留的是被解出 2 到 14 次的子题。

Gemma-2-9B-it 从种子集中最常见的 100 个技能里，为每个子题分配不超过三个技能，这些技能集定义多样性单元。静态变体始终只变异种子 working set；动态变体会插入高质量子题并淘汰低质量成员。均匀变体直接均匀抽父样本，多样性变体则先均匀抽技能单元。所有子题都进入 archive，但只有质量为正的子题通过最终筛选。

最终监督轨迹由学生编写。每个保留题与它的全部成功学生验证配对，而不是与生成器的预期解配对。因此，solve-rate 结果既是构造评分，也产生推理轨迹。它属于质量—多样性数据课程，不是 RLVR 优化器：论文报告的下游更新是 SFT，数值 checker 也只作用在最终答案层面。

title: Method
方法
html:
The working set begins with the 7.5K MATH training pairs. The student is pretrained Gemma-2-9B fine-tuned on those seeds for three epochs. Unless an ablation changes the role assignment, Gemma-2-27B-it generates child problem-solution pairs and Gemma-2-9B-it labels their skills. Appendix F prints prompts that pass the parent problem and solution to the mutation model, request a novel problem plus solution with an intended numerical answer, and ask the classifier for at most three relevant skills.

Each mutation step samples 64 parents. The generator writes children, the classifier assigns skill cells, and the student produces 16 solution rollouts per child. Numerical final-answer agreement with the intended answer produces binary verification labels. Solve rate aggregates them; quality is (1-)solve-rate inside inclusive [0.1, 0.9] and zero outside. Every child enters the archive. Depending on the variant, the working set stays fixed, holds the globally highest-quality items, or maintains capped high-quality populations within skill cells.

Each main method runs for at most 5,000 mutation steps, giving 320K child problem-solution pairs and roughly 5M student verification solutions. Because most children have solve rate zero, the authors report an average of about 80K retained unique problems and 500K problem/successful-solution tuples per method. The multiple successful solutions per problem bias tuple counts toward easier retained questions. An ablation removes 75% of successful traces for problems with solve rate at least 0.5, shrinking one 500K-tuple set to 350K with mixed downstream effects.

For fixed-budget analysis, the authors take a 300K static-uniform archive, remove zero-quality pairs, keep one successful student solution per question, and compare quality, diversity, joint QD, and random sampling at budgets from (2^{12}) to (2^{15}). Downstream training uses one epoch, batch size 16, learning rate 2e-6 with cosine decay to 2e-7, on an 8x8 TPUv4 slice. Initial SFT settings beyond three epochs, generation hardware, temperatures, seeds, parser rules, and answer-normalization details are unknown.

working set 由 7.5K 条 MATH 训练题解对初始化。学生模型是先在这些种子上训练三个 epoch 的预训练 Gemma-2-9B。除角色消融外，Gemma-2-27B-it 生成子题解对，Gemma-2-9B-it 标注技能。附录 F 给出提示模板：把父题和解答传给变异模型，要求输出带预期数值答案的新题与新解；分类器最多返回三个相关技能。

每个变异步骤抽取 64 个父样本。生成器写出子题，分类器分配技能单元，学生为每个子题生成 16 条解答。提取的最终数值答案与预期答案是否一致，形成二元验证标签；solve rate 对其求平均；质量在闭区间 [0.1, 0.9] 内等于 (1-)solve-rate，区间外为零。所有子题都写入 archive。不同变体会保持 working set 不变、保留全局最高质量样本，或在各技能单元内维持有容量上限的高质量成员。

每种主要方法最多运行 5,000 个变异步骤，得到 320K 个子题解对和约 500 万条学生验证解。由于多数子题的 solve rate 为零，作者报告每种方法平均约保留 80K 道唯一题目和 500K 个题目/成功解元组。同题的多个成功解会让较容易的保留题贡献更多元组。消融实验删除 solve rate 至少 0.5 的题目中 75% 的成功轨迹，把一组 500K 元组缩减为 350K，下游效果并不一致。

固定预算分析使用 300K 条静态均匀 archive，删除零质量题解对，每题仅保留一条成功学生解，再在 (2^{12}) 到 (2^{15}) 的预算下比较 quality、diversity、联合 QD 和 random 抽样。下游训练一个 epoch，批量大小 16，学习率从 2e-6 余弦衰减到 2e-7，运行在 8x8 TPUv4 slice 上。初始 SFT 除三个 epoch 外的设置、生成硬件、temperature、seed、parser 规则和答案归一化细节均未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For the main search comparison, static uniform improves the reported MATH pass@1 of the MATH-SFT Gemma-2-9B student from 38% to 47%. With 100K generated problems and 96 inference samples on AIME, the paper reports 20% for the SFT baseline and 25% for static uniform. Dynamic diverse generation discovers more skill-set combinations—5,000 after 100K generated problems versus 4,250 for static uniform—but its final MATH result is 44%, below static uniform’s 47%.

Fixed-budget filtering isolates a different question from generation policy. Joint quality-diversity filtering reaches 45.5% MATH with 32K SFT examples, within 1.5 points of static uniform trained on 500K tuples. Diversity-only filtering improves AIME pass@96 from 19% for random filtering to 25%; the gap becomes visible from 16 inference samples onward. Higher mean paper-defined quality correlates with better MATH performance for training sets of at least 8,192 examples.

The paper also audits the proxy. Gemini-2.5-flash produces alternative solutions for 1,000 generated pairs, and intended-answer agreement is used as a model-based validity label. The resulting bins show that lower solve rate correlates with lower validity. Appendix B then tests whether 16 child mutations can identify invalid parents; valid and invalid groups have the same mean child-parent score difference of 0.03 and about 28% zero-score children, so the proposed perturbative signal fails to separate them.

These results show how the recipe behaves under the reported Gemma-2 models, learned skills, and answer checker. They do not establish that every retained row is valid, diverse in a semantic sense, uncontaminated, or legally reusable. No archive or selected tuples were released for independent recounting.

主要搜索策略对比中，静态均匀方法把经过 MATH SFT 的 Gemma-2-9B 在 MATH 上的 pass@1 从 38% 提升到 47%。使用 100K 道生成题并在 AIME 上采样 96 次时，论文报告 SFT baseline 为 20%，静态均匀方法为 25%。动态多样性方法在生成 100K 道题后发现 5,000 个技能集组合，静态均匀为 4,250 个；但它最终的 MATH 成绩是 44%，低于静态均匀的 47%。

固定预算筛选回答的是另一个问题。联合质量—多样性筛选用 32K 条 SFT 样本取得 45.5% MATH，距使用 500K 元组的静态均匀结果仅 1.5 个百分点。diversity-only 筛选把 AIME pass@96 从 random 的 19% 提高到 25%，差距从 16 次推理采样开始显现。当训练集至少包含 8,192 条样本时，论文定义的平均质量与更好的 MATH 表现正相关。

论文还直接审核了代理信号。Gemini-2.5-flash 为 1,000 个生成题解对给出替代解，再根据其答案与预期答案是否一致生成模型式有效性标签。分箱结果表明 solve rate 越低，有效性越低。附录 B 又测试 16 个子变异能否识别无效父样本；有效与无效两组的平均子题—父题分数差都为 0.03，零分子题比例都约为 28%，因此该扰动信号无法区分两组。

这些结果只说明配方在既定 Gemma-2 模型、学习式技能标签和答案 checker 下的行为，不能证明每条保留记录都有效、具有语义多样性、无污染或可合法复用。由于没有发布 archive 或选后元组，也无法独立重计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most synthetic reasoning pipelines either keep questions fixed and sample additional solutions or generate new questions without an explicit search archive. SPARQ changes the searched object to problem statements and intended solutions. A current student’s solve rate supplies a difficulty-shaped quality signal, while model-assigned skill cells supply a behavioral descriptor for quality-diversity selection. Successful verifier rollouts are then recycled as SFT traces.

The four archive policies make the quality/diversity tradeoff operational. Static versus dynamic determines whether descendants can become future parents; uniform versus diverse determines whether selection is over individual examples or skill cells. This design exposes a concrete direction signal: the policy that produces the most measured skill coverage is not the one that gives the strongest downstream model, and recursively selecting difficult items can amplify invalid parents by reward-hacking the quality proxy.

The paper also tests recursive problem self-generation with Gemma-2-2B and Gemma-2-9B acting as both generator and student, reporting relative gains after 300K children. What is not new should remain explicit: numerical answer checking, SFT, evolutionary mutation, skill tagging, and solve-rate curricula all have prior lineages. SPARQ’s contribution is their assembly and systematic ablation for open-ended math-problem data, not a released dataset or correctness verifier.

多数合成推理流水线要么固定题目只增加解答，要么生成新题却不维护明确的搜索 archive。SPARQ 把被搜索对象改为题面和预期解：当前学生的 solve rate 提供难度型质量信号，模型分配的技能单元为质量—多样性选择提供行为描述符，成功验证 rollout 再被回收为 SFT 轨迹。

四种 archive 策略使质量/多样性权衡变得可操作。静态或动态决定子代能否成为未来父样本，均匀或多样性决定按单样本还是按技能单元抽样。该设计揭示了具体方向信号：测得技能覆盖最多的策略并未得到最强下游模型；递归选择困难题还可能放大无效父样本，对质量代理形成 reward hacking。

论文还让 Gemma-2-2B 和 Gemma-2-9B 同时担任生成器与学生，测试递归自出题，并报告生成 300K 个子样本后的相对提升。需要明确的是，数值答案检查、SFT、演化变异、技能标注和 solve-rate curriculum 都有前序工作。SPARQ 的贡献是面向开放数学题数据对这些部件进行组合和系统消融，而不是发布数据集或提出正确性 verifier。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Numerical agreement is checked against a model-generated intended answer. Invalid premises, wrong intended answers shared by the student, lucky guesses, or flawed intermediate reasoning can all pass.
  • Difficulty is policy-relative. A valid problem outside Gemma-2-9B’s competence can receive zero quality, while a familiar or answer-leaking problem can appear easy and be removed.
  • The paper’s Gemini-2.5-flash probe finds harder accepted pairs more likely invalid. Dynamic working sets can recursively propagate such high-scoring invalid parents and reward-hack the proxy.
  • The attempted perturbative validity signal does not separate valid and invalid parents: both groups show a 0.03 mean child-parent score difference and roughly 28% zero-score children in the appendix experiment.
  • Most children have solve rate zero. Sixteen student generations per child therefore produce roughly 5M verification solutions for a 320K archive with only about 80K retained questions on average.
  • Pairing every successful rollout with a retained question oversamples easier accepted problems. Removing 75% of easy traces has mixed effects, so tuple multiplicity remains a design choice.
  • Diversity is bounded by Gemma-2-9B-it labels, the 100 most frequent seed skills, and at most three skills per question. Coverage can reflect classifier vocabulary or errors rather than semantic diversity.
  • No official code, generated archive, working-set history, selected tuple IDs, checkpoint, decoding settings, seeds, deduplication report, decontamination ledger, or generated-data license was confirmed.
  • The paper license is CC BY 4.0, but this does not establish terms for an unreleased MATH-derived corpus or implementation.

• 数值一致是相对于模型生成的预期答案检查的；无效前提、生成器与学生共享的错误答案、碰巧猜对或错误中间推理都可能通过。
  • 难度依赖当前策略。超出 Gemma-2-9B 能力的有效题可能被赋零质量，熟悉或泄漏答案的题则可能显得过易并被删除。
  • 论文的 Gemini-2.5-flash 探针发现，较难的保留题解对更可能无效；动态 working set 会递归传播这些高分无效父样本并 reward-hack 代理。
  • 附录尝试的扰动有效性信号无法区分有效与无效父样本：两组平均子题—父题分数差都是 0.03，零分子题比例都约为 28%。
  • 多数子题 solve rate 为零。每题 16 次学生生成使 320K archive 产生约 500 万条验证解，而平均只保留约 80K 道题。
  • 为每道保留题保留全部成功 rollout，会过采样较容易的已接收题。删除 75% 简单题轨迹的效果不稳定，因此元组重复权重仍是设计选择。
  • 多样性受 Gemma-2-9B-it 标签、100 个最常见种子技能和每题最多三个标签限制；覆盖量可能反映分类器词表或错误，而非语义多样性。
  • 尚未确认官方代码、生成 archive、working-set 历史、选后元组 ID、checkpoint、解码设置、seed、去重报告、去污染 ledger 或生成数据许可。
  • 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但这不能为未发布的 MATH 衍生语料或实现确定条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, SPARQ is a detailed blueprint for evolving a synthetic mathematics curriculum while tracking policy-relative difficulty and learned coverage. It specifies the seed, generator/student/classifier roles, mutation prompts, rollout count, checker contract, quality thresholds, skill representation, four search policies, filtering step, tuple assembly, scale, and downstream SFT settings. The missing release means the blueprint is reproducible only after substantial implementation work.

A robust reimplementation should preserve seed and parent IDs, generator/student/classifier revisions, generated intended answer, all 16 raw student solutions, extracted answers, agreement labels, solve rate, quality, skill-label evidence, archive cell, working-set replacement, rejection reason, and final tuple ID. It should also store a one-question-one-weight view in addition to the paper’s all-successful-solution tuples so multiplicity bias can be measured.

Before reuse as training data, add an independent well-posedness and answer-equivalence gate, retain disagreement and rejected cases, quantify false acceptance, audit the skill taxonomy, compare static and dynamic invalidity propagation, and pin deduplication, decontamination, compute, and license records. Benchmark gains justify studying the recipe; they do not certify the constructed examples. This distinction is the Card’s main value to the assigned track.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 轨道而言，SPARQ 是一条同时追踪策略相对难度和学习式覆盖范围的合成数学课程蓝图。它明确了种子、生成器/学生/分类器角色、变异 prompt、rollout 数、checker 契约、质量阈值、技能表示、四种搜索策略、筛选步骤、元组组装、运行规模和下游 SFT 设置。由于缺少 artifact 发布，该蓝图仍需较多实现工作才能复现。

稳健复现应保留 seed/parent ID，生成器、学生和分类器版本，生成的预期答案，全部 16 条原始学生解，提取答案，一致标签，solve rate，质量，技能标签证据，archive 单元，working-set 替换，拒绝原因和最终 tuple ID。除论文采用的“保留全部成功解”视图外，还应保存每题等权视图，便于量化重复权重偏差。

把数据用于训练前，应增加独立的题目良定义性与答案等价门控，保留分歧和拒绝案例，量化误接收，审核技能 taxonomy，比较静态与动态的无效样本传播，并固定去重、去污染、计算和许可记录。Benchmark 提升只能说明该配方值得研究，不能认证每个构造样本。这一区分是本卡与指定轨道连接的核心。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Sections 2–3 and Appendix F: MATH supplies 7.5K seeds, Gemma-2-27B-it mutates parents, Gemma-2-9B-it assigns up to three skills, and a MATH-SFT Gemma-2-9B produces 16 verification solutions.
  • Read quality literally as (1-)solve-rate only within [0.1, 0.9]. Verification is numerical agreement with a generated intended answer, not independent proof checking.
  • Distinguish the 320K all-generation archive, about 80K retained unique problems, and about 500K retained problem/successful-solution tuples; they are different data objects with different multiplicities.
  • Compare search and filtering results separately: dynamic diverse generation maximizes measured skill coverage, static uniform gives the strongest main downstream model, and joint QD filtering is strongest under fixed sample budgets.
  • Treat the validity probe and Appendix B as central evidence. Harder accepted items are more often invalid, and child-score statistics do not repair that failure; code, corpus, schema, temperature, decontamination, and data license remain unknown.

• 先读第 2–3 节与附录 F：MATH 提供 7.5K 种子，Gemma-2-27B-it 变异父样本，Gemma-2-9B-it 最多分配三个技能，经过 MATH SFT 的 Gemma-2-9B 生成 16 条验证解。
  • 严格把质量读作仅在 [0.1, 0.9] 内成立的 (1-)solve-rate。这里的验证是与生成预期答案的数值一致，不是独立 proof checking。
  • 区分 320K 条全生成 archive、约 80K 道保留唯一题目和约 500K 个题目/成功解元组；它们是重复权重不同的三类数据对象。
  • 分开比较搜索与筛选结果：dynamic diverse 最大化测得技能覆盖，static uniform 得到最强主要下游模型，联合 QD 在固定样本预算下最好。
  • 把有效性探针和附录 B 视为核心证据：较难保留题更常无效，子题分数统计也不能修复该问题；代码、语料、schema、temperature、去污染和数据许可仍为 unknown。

value.html: A two-phase quality-diversity search first mutates a static or dynamically updated working set into an all-generation archive, then filters the archive by policy-relative solve rate and assembles SFT tuples.

value_zh.html: 两阶段质量-多样性搜索首先将静态或动态更新的工作集变异为全代档案，然后按策略相对解题率过滤档案并组装 SFT 元组。

value.html: Each child receives 16 student rollouts checked by numerical final-answer agreement with its intended answer; solve rate is their agreement fraction, and quality is 1 minus solve rate only inside inclusive [0.1, 0.9].

value_zh.html: 每个子问题接受 16 次学生 rollouts，按与预定答案的数值最终答案一致检查；解题率为其一致比例，质量仅在闭区间 [0.1, 0.9] 内为 1 减去解题率。

value.html: A problem survives archive filtering when its solve rate is within [0.1, 0.9], and each SFT tuple additionally requires a student rollout whose final numerical answer matches the intended answer; neither condition proves well-posedness or reasoning validity.

value_zh.html: 当解题率在 [0.1, 0.9] 内时问题通过档案过滤，且每个 SFT 元组额外要求一次最终数值答案匹配预定答案的学生 rollout；两个条件均不证明适定性或推理有效性。

value.html: Pretrained Gemma-2-9B fine-tuned for three epochs on the MATH seed is the student; same-model Gemma-2-2B and Gemma-2-9B generators are tested in recursive self-improvement experiments.

value_zh.html: 在 MATH 种子上微调三个 epochs 的预训练 Gemma-2-9B 为学生；递归自我改进实验测试同模型 Gemma-2-2B 与 Gemma-2-9B 生成器。

value.html: Gemma-2-27B-it is the default problem generator; successful Gemma-2-9B student verifications, rather than the generator's intended solutions, become downstream SFT traces.

value_zh.html: Gemma-2-27B-it 为默认问题生成器；成功的 Gemma-2-9B 学生核验而非生成器的预定解答成为下游 SFT 轨迹。

value.html: Sample a parent problem and solution, ask Gemma-2-27B-it to generate a novel child problem and intended solution, then use Gemma-2-9B-it to assign up to three skills from the 100 most common seed skills.

value_zh.html: 采样一个父问题与解答，让 Gemma-2-27B-it 生成新的子问题与预定解答，然后用 Gemma-2-9B-it 从 100 个最常见种子技能中分配至多三个技能。

value.html: Initialize from MATH, sample 64 parents per mutation step, generate children, classify skills, run 16 student verifications, append every child to the archive, optionally update the working set, then filter and construct problem/student-solution tuples.

value_zh.html: 从 MATH 初始化，每变异步采样 64 个父项，生成子问题，分类技能，运行 16 次学生核验，将每个子问题追加到档案，可选更新工作集，然后过滤并构造问题/学生解答元组。

value.html: Set quality to 1 minus solve rate for solve rates in [0.1, 0.9] and zero otherwise; retain all successful student verifications for each positive-quality problem. Static/dynamic and uniform/diverse variants change parent selection and working-set replacement.

value.html: Each main method runs at most 5,000 mutation steps, producing a 320K-child archive and about 5M student verification solutions; average retained output is about 80K unique problems and 500K tuples per method.

value_zh.html: 每个主方法至多运行 5,000 个变异步，产生 320K 子问题档案与约 5M 条学生核验解答；平均保留输出约为每方法 80K 道独特问题与 500K 个元组。

value.html: Four search variants—static uniform, static diverse, dynamic uniform, and dynamic diverse—precede one-epoch downstream SFT at learning rate 2e-6 cosine-decayed to 2e-7 with batch size 16 on an 8x8 TPUv4 slice.

items: Numerical agreement with a generated intended answer can accept invalid premises, shared answer errors, lucky guesses, or flawed intermediate reasoning.
The paper finds harder accepted problem-solution pairs more likely invalid under a Gemini-2.5-flash alternative-solution probe.
Dynamic working sets can propagate high-scoring invalid parents and reward-hack the solve-rate proxy.
Most generated problems have solve rate zero, causing low retained-problem yield and roughly 16 verification generations per child.
Retaining every successful verification oversamples easier accepted problems because they contribute more SFT traces.
Diversity depends on a learned taxonomy of 100 seed skills and no more than three labels per problem.
Perturbative child-score statistics did not separate valid from invalid parents in the appendix experiment.
No official code, corpus, immutable archive, tuple IDs, decoding settings, decontamination ledger, or generated-data license was confirmed.
与生成预定答案的数值一致可能接受无效前提、共享答案错误、幸运猜测或有缺陷的中间推理。
论文发现更难的已接受问题-解答对在 Gemini-2.5-flash 替代解答探测下更可能无效。
动态工作集可能传播高分无效父项并对解题率代理进行奖励劫持。
大多数生成问题解题率为零，导致低保留问题产出，且每个子问题约 16 次核验生成。
保留每一次成功核验会过采样较易的已接受问题，因为它们贡献更多 SFT 轨迹。
多样性依赖于 100 个种子技能的习得分类体系，且每题不超过三个标签。
在附录实验中，扰动子分数统计未能将有效父项与无效父项分开。
